title: Diagram spec (two-layer: semantic model + house-style binding)
description: A single diagram instance for the /diagram knowledge kit. Two-layer per Design 15: a notation-neutral SEMANTIC MODEL (token, nodes/slots role-tagged, edges, drilldown {ref,rel}) separated from a thin HOUSE-STYLE BINDING (style: house@<Grammar-version> + legend/header per-instance specifics only). Discriminated over the 7 `token` values via oneOf. The house standard (role->shape/color, header/legend/terminal-artifact rules) is RESOLVED from the pinned grammar via diagram-house-profile.md and is NOT inlined here.

id.description: Stable instance id. IS the specId (the manifest correlation token, written into the rendered doc as a sentinel shape id `__specid__<id>`). Drilldown refs target this by id.

schemaVersion.description: Spec SERIALIZATION-structure pin (contract #1). The resolver rejects a spec whose schemaVersion it does not support. Independent of style/Grammar-version.

style.description: HOUSE-STYLE BINDING pin: the house semantics version this spec is rendered to. The standard itself is resolved from the Design-14 grammar at this version via diagram-house-profile.md, never inlined. A composite is grammar-homogeneous: all drilldown-reachable instances pin the same value.

token.description: The discriminator. Closed 7-value enum (Design 14's 6 archetypes with layered-cake split into -kit and -signal). `token` is the spec field / schema enum / slot allow-list value; `archetype` is the conceptual 6-member grouping and is NOT a spec field.

title.description: Plain human Title-Case name (house header rule, resolved from grammar). ASCII-only; never the archetype taxonomy. Per-instance house-style specific.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line human-facing descriptor centered beneath the title (house header rule). ASCII-only.

legend.description: HOUSE-STYLE BINDING: non-empty color->role legend. Lists exactly the roles present in this diagram (conformance rule resolved from the grammar via the profile). Role/color tokens are validated against the grammar by the profile-resolved rule set, not enumerated here.

nodes.description: SEMANTIC MODEL: role-tagged nodes/slots. A node carrying `drilldown` is a slot. Notation-neutral; no per-node color/shape literals (those are resolved from role via the grammar).

bands.description: SEMANTIC MODEL: ordered role-tagged bands (bottom->top for layered-cake, left->right for pipeline/cross-cutting). Order is the lowering input; geometry is a pure function of it.

edges.description: SEMANTIC MODEL: directed edges between node/band ids, typed by `kind`. (Design 14 calls these arrows; the spec field is `edges`.)

roleToken.description: A role name. The role->shape and role->color binding is resolved from the Design-14 grammar at the pinned version via diagram-house-profile.md (one shape per role, one color per role). Not enumerated in the schema so the schema does not re-encode the grammar; tier-(b) conformance checks membership.

relToken.description: Typed drilldown relationship (e.g. expands-to). The child holds no back-pointer.

color.description: House color token, #RRGGBB (LucidAdapter constraint). Validated against the grammar palette by the profile-resolved rule set.

drilldown.description: Composability pointer (by id). `ref` targets another instance's id; `rel` is the typed relationship. Resolver: ref must resolve (unresolved-ref); child token must be in the slot allow-list declared per slot-role in kit-<token>.md (token-not-allowed); the drilldown graph is a DAG (cycle-detected, visited-set); depth bound is fixed at 3 with root=depth-1, so depth-exceeded fires at depth > 3; all reachable instances share one Grammar-version (grammar-version-mismatch).

band.description: Optional id of the band this node belongs to.

order.description: Position in the bottom->top (layered-cake) or left->right (pipeline/cross-cutting) sequence. Drives deterministic layout.

kind.description: Arrow semantics from the grammar (resolved by the profile). Enumerated here as the closed serialization set per Design 14's arrow vocabulary.

bands.description: >=1 knowledge band (kit floor; the kit-strategy seed targets >=3) feeding a skill node feeding an expert node.
>=2 source nodes -> MCP-tool band -> reasoning/decision band -> expert-or-cohort node.
>=2 ordered stages, left->right; a gate is a bold-bordered node. Drilldown slot allow-list (MVP): linear-pipeline.stage -> { circular-cohort } (declared in kit-linear-pipeline.md).
A lifecycle base of >=2 stages + exactly 1 overlay band touching >=2 of them.
